q1: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2: SELECT FOLLOWER, NUM FROM (SELECT DISTINCT FOLLOWER, (SELECT COUNT(F2.FOLLOWEE) FROM FOLLOW F2 WHERE F2.FOLLOWEE = F1.FOLLOWER) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW F1) AS S WHERE S.NUM > 0 ORDER BY FOLLOWER ASC

explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent. Q1 selects followers who are also being followed by other followers and counts how many followers each of them has. Q2 selects followers and the count of followers they have, but it only considers followers who have at least one follower.
counterexample_dsp: A test case where a follower has no followers of their own, but is followed by other followers.
